Container.Name: nocturne-postgres-server
Container.Overview: Step 1 of 4: dedicated PostgreSQL 17 database for Nocturne. Run prepare.sh first to generate credentials and bootstrap files. Install all four templates on the nocturne custom network. Database initialization runs only on an empty data directory. Do not reuse a Nightscout MongoDB directory.
Container.Requires: Run nocturne/prepare.sh before installation. Requires all four Nocturne containers, a custom Docker network named nocturne, generated private environment files and an HTTPS reverse proxy. See ReadMe.

Config.Name: Database storage
Config.Description: Dedicated persistent PostgreSQL 17 data. Back up before version changes.

Config.Name: Database bootstrap
Config.Description: Generated by prepare.sh; this is a file, not a directory.
